metadata.description: Benchmark tasks for Paper A: Parallel Context Architecture

code_refactoring.name: Code Refactoring
code_refactoring.description: Tasks requiring exploration of multiple refactoring approaches

debugging.name: Debugging
debugging.description: Tasks requiring validation of multiple bug hypotheses

creative_writing.name: Creative Writing
creative_writing.description: Tasks requiring exploration of different narrative directions

research.name: Research
research.description: Tasks requiring comparison of multiple design options

tasks.title: Explore 3 Refactoring Approaches for Legacy Module
tasks.description: Refactor a legacy Rust module using three different approaches: (1) incremental refactoring, (2) complete rewrite, (3) wrapper-based modernization. Compare trade-offs and merge the best solution.

tasks.title: Compare Dependency Injection Patterns
tasks.description: Explore three dependency injection patterns: constructor injection, setter injection, and interface injection. Evaluate each pattern and select the best fit.
success_criteria: Three DI patterns implemented in separate branches

tasks.title: Experiment with Caching Strategies
tasks.description: Implement and compare three caching strategies: LRU, LFU, and time-based expiration. Measure performance impact of each strategy.
success_criteria: Best strategy selected based on metrics

tasks.title: Refactor Error Handling Patterns
tasks.description: Explore different error handling patterns: Result types, custom error enums, and error context wrappers.

tasks.title: Optimize Data Structure Choices
tasks.description: Compare different data structures (Vec, HashMap, BTreeMap) for a specific use case and select the optimal one.

tasks.title: Explore Async vs Sync Implementations
tasks.description: Implement both synchronous and asynchronous versions of I/O-bound operations and compare performance.

tasks.title: Validate 3 Bug Hypotheses for Crash
tasks.description: A production crash occurs. Explore three hypotheses: (1) null pointer dereference, (2) race condition, (3) resource exhaustion.
success_criteria: Three hypotheses explored in parallel branches

tasks.title: Trace Memory Leak Through Multiple Paths
tasks.description: Memory leak detected. Explore multiple potential leak sources: unclosed files, circular references, forgotten subscriptions.

tasks.title: Debug Intermittent Test Failures
tasks.description: Tests fail intermittently. Explore potential causes: timing issues, shared state, random seed dependency.

tasks.title: Fix Performance Regression
tasks.description: Performance regression detected. Explore potential causes: algorithmic complexity, I/O bottlenecks, memory allocation patterns.

tasks.title: Resolve API Integration Failures
tasks.description: Third-party API integration failing. Explore causes: authentication issues, rate limiting, API version mismatch.

tasks.title: Debug Concurrent Access Issues
tasks.description: Data corruption under concurrent access. Explore solutions: mutex-based locking, lock-free data structures, actor model.

tasks.title: Explore Different Plot Directions
tasks.description: Write a short story with three different plot twists. Evaluate which creates the most engaging narrative.

tasks.title: Develop Multiple Character Arcs
tasks.description: Develop a character through three different arcs: redemption, fall from grace, and steady growth.

tasks.title: Experiment with Narrative Perspectives
tasks.description: Tell the same story from three perspectives: first person, third person limited, and omniscient narrator.

tasks.title: Explore Different Genre Treatments
tasks.description: Write the same scene in three genres: thriller, romance, and comedy.

tasks.title: Develop Alternative Endings
tasks.description: Write three alternative endings for a story: happy, tragic, and ambiguous.
success_criteria: Each ending satisfying in its own way

tasks.title: Experiment with Pacing Variations
tasks.description: Write the same scene with three pacing approaches: fast-paced action, slow contemplative, and balanced.

tasks.title: Compare API Design Patterns
tasks.description: Design the same API using three patterns: REST, GraphQL, and gRPC. Compare trade-offs for the use case.

tasks.title: Evaluate Database Schema Options
tasks.description: Design database schemas using three approaches: relational, document-based, and graph database.

tasks.title: Compare Authentication Mechanisms
tasks.description: Implement three authentication mechanisms: JWT tokens, OAuth 2.0, and session-based auth.

tasks.title: Explore Deployment Strategies
tasks.description: Design deployment strategies: blue-green, canary, and rolling deployments.

tasks.title: Evaluate Logging Architectures
tasks.description: Design logging architectures: centralized logging, distributed tracing, and hybrid approach.

tasks.title: Compare Testing Strategies
tasks.description: Implement three testing strategies: test pyramid, testing trophy, and end-to-end focused.

exploration_depth.description: Average number of branches explored per task

error_recovery_rate.description: Percentage of failed branches that were successfully recovered

time_efficiency.description: Ratio of actual time to estimated time

experimental_protocol.design: Crossover design: each participant uses both linear and parallel systems
experimental_protocol.counterbalancing: Half participants start with linear, half with parallel
